Python SDK: _transform_recursive blocking event loop on large message payloads

Structured output + thinking + tool use: two bugs in multi-turn conversations
Bedrock beta.messages missing .stream() method
Slow imports
Streaming tool use: unhelpful error message when model emits malformed JSON (non-beta path missing try-except)
BetaAsyncAbstractMemoryTool docstring contains sync-only example (copy-paste from sync class)
[BUG] `client.beta.files.upload`  `PathLike` error
pdfplumber broken in code_execution sandbox — charset_normalizer mypyc module missing
beta.skills.list hard-capped at 100 items with broken pagination (has_more always false, no cursor)
BetaInputJsonEvent not fired for server_tool_use blocks during streaming
`get_final_message()` does not propagate `message_delta.container` into aggregated Message (breaks code_execution continuation)
API "Streaming is required" error message is outdated
Container File Mounting
`BetaCitationPageLocation` contains `file_id` that cannot be roundtripped as a request
ToolUseBlock and ToolUseBlockParam type conflict for caller nullability
Bedrock streaming SSE events errors are not handled gracefully
Accept a callable for bearer-token auth (`auth_token: str | Callable[[], str]`)
[Bug] append_messages() inside tool runner loop causes infinite loop (advanced usage docs example)
Official Rust SDK request — Where The Rust At? (follow-up to #747)
[Bug] API returns 400 'Invalid signature in thinking block' when replaying conversation history — no recovery path
BUG: construct_type() raises IndexError when called with bare unparameterized list
IndexError on bare (unparameterized) dict annotation in _transform_recursive
BUG: construct_type() crashes with ValueError when type_ is a bare dict

Streaming response consumption validates full event union per event on the loop, even for get_final_message()
Managed Agents event stream doesn't surface model refusal stop_reason / stop_details
web_search_20260209 dynamic filtering: code execution fails with "AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'get'" and returns empty results — need help understanding
[Beta Sessions / Managed Agents] MCP tool-result image content blocks reach the model as base64 text instead of vision
x-stainless-timeout header is NOT_GIVEN on default requests
[BUG] PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue warnings on every `message_stop` event when streaming
environments work poller: ack-before-yield makes any consumer failure permanently strand the work item — request deferred ack or a nack/fail API
[BUG] MCP connector: parallel mcp_tool_use calls stall ~300s per turn; one call per batch runs twice
SessionToolRunner can re-execute a tool call after a stream reconnect if its result post failed
Consider migrating from httpx to httpx2
backoff() raises OverflowError instead of returning the cap for very large attempt counts
First API request forks a subprocess via platform.platform() — child segfaults on macOS in long-running processes
transform_schema raises AssertionError on valid list-form types, e.g. {"type": ["string", "null"]}
`AsyncAnthropicBedrock` blocks the event loop during AWS credential resolution or signing
AttributeError: 'WindowsPath' object has no attribute 'read'
Self-hosted environments: outcome grader's tool results rejected with 400, so grading never completes
Streaming: response pausing for a client tool while a code execution is pending never includes the container id — continuation then rejected as "container_id is required"
Streaming accumulator crashes when message_start omits usage as shown in thinking docs
transform_schema empties a patternProperties map: field can only ever be {}
output_config.format cannot take the pydantic model that output_format deprecates, and the dict workaround silently skips transform_schema
